import sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
import importlib.util, json, os, subprocess, tempfile, time
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
p=Path('Scripts/Audit/audit_miniapp_reachability.py')
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('reachability',p)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
checks=[]
def rejected(call, expected):
    try: call()
    except ValueError as error:
        assert expected in str(error), str(error)
        return str(error)
    raise AssertionError('Expected strict source rejection')
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='hanlin-reachability-reader-',dir='/dev/shm') as tmp:
    root=Path(tmp)
    env=dict(os.environ,GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='ChatGPT',GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL='chatgpt@users.noreply.github.com',GIT_COMMITTER_NAME='ChatGPT',GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL='chatgpt@users.noreply.github.com')
    def git(*args): return subprocess.run(['git',*args],cwd=root,env=env,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
    git('init','-q')
    (root/'Local.swift').write_text('let local = 1\n')
    (root/'Sparse.swift').write_text('let original = 2\n')
    git('add','Local.swift','Sparse.swift'); git('commit','-qm','reader fixture')
    (root/'Local.swift').write_text('let local = 9\n')
    (root/'Sparse.swift').unlink()
    reader=mod.TrackedSources(root);reader.prefetch(['Local.swift','Sparse.swift'])
    assert reader.read_text('Local.swift')=='let local = 9\n'
    assert reader.read_text('Sparse.swift')=='let original = 2\n'
    checks.append({'name':'local edits win; missing tracked Swift reads exact HEAD bytes in one batch','pass':True})
    (root/'Untracked.swift').write_text('untracked')
    rejected(lambda:reader.read_bytes('Untracked.swift'),'not a normalized tracked file')
    rejected(lambda:reader.read_bytes('Missing.swift'),'not a normalized tracked file')
    (root/'Staged.swift').write_text('new');git('add','Staged.swift');(root/'Staged.swift').unlink()
    rejected(lambda:mod.TrackedSources(root).read_bytes('Staged.swift'),'Missing tracked HEAD source')
    checks.append({'name':'untracked existing/missing files and absent HEAD blobs remain rejected','pass':True})
sdk=Path('docs/miniapp-sdk/source-inventory.json');before=sdk.read_bytes()
authority=Path('/dev/shm/hanlin-reachability-authority-20261124.json').read_bytes()
try:
    sdk.write_bytes(authority)
    started=time.monotonic(); value=mod.build()
    assert len(value['matrix'])==80
    assert len({(r['surface'],r['engine'],r['runtime'])for r in value['matrix']})==80
    assert all(not r['realSurfaceE2E']and r['onDeviceProof']is None for r in value['matrix'])
    assert all(r['sourcePathReachesCanonicalExecutor']==(r['surface']in ['foreground','share','translation','hostAppIntent','shortcuts'])for r in value['matrix'])
    assert all(r['runtimeTail']==[]for r in value['matrix']if r['surface']in ['widget','notification','liveActivity'])
    assert all(not r['structuredReceiptReturnedToIngressInSource']for r in value['matrix']if r['surface']!='foreground')
    controls=value['originalLibrarySurfaces']['scriptWidgetControls']
    assert controls['status']=='source-wired'and controls['canonicalHostRuntimePassthroughEstablished']is False
    assert all(not r['realSurfaceE2E']for r in value['originalLibrarySurfaces'].values())
    assert len(value['entitlements'])==9
    text=mod.markdown(value)
    assert 'ControlWidget/CoreSpotlight names occur'not in text
    assert 'Expo action parity remains disconnected'not in text
    assert 'Original library surfaces outside the 80 cells'in text
    checks.append({'name':'real sparse source graph preserves80 canonical cells and separates4 original UI/action surfaces','pass':True,'elapsedSeconds':round(time.monotonic()-started,3),'sdkSourceCount':len(value['sdkSources']),'referenceCount':len(value['sourceRefs']),'declaredEntitlementFiles':len(value['entitlements']),'statuses':{s:sum(r['status']==s for r in value['matrix'])for s in ['not-tested','partially-wired','disconnected']}})
    wrong=json.loads(authority);wrong['sources'][0]['sha256']='0'*64;sdk.write_text(json.dumps(wrong))
    error=rejected(mod.build,'SDK authority is stale:')
    sdk.write_bytes(authority)
    original_read=mod.TrackedSources.read_bytes
    def changed_anchor(self,file):
        data=original_read(self,file)
        return data.replace(b'public struct ScriptWidgetButtonControlWidget: ControlWidget',b'public struct ChangedOriginalControl: ControlWidget')if file.endswith('/Original/ScriptWidgetControlWidget.swift')else data
    with patch.object(mod.TrackedSources,'read_bytes',changed_anchor):
        anchor_error=rejected(mod.build,'Audit anchor changed:')
    checks.append({'name':'SDK hash drift and removed real original ControlWidget anchor both fail','pass':True,'hashFailure':error,'anchorFailure':anchor_error})
finally:
    sdk.write_bytes(before)
assert sdk.read_bytes()==before
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','checks':checks,'noInventoriesWritten':True,'boundary':'Reader/source-graph/strict-drift checks only; no native or physical execution.'},indent=2))
